MODE T (unattended test): the test Chrome is OFF-SCREEN and MUTED — box/hbprobe-launch.bat starts it with --window-position=-32000,-32000 --mute-audio. Verify off-screen + muted before any login; no sound may ever reach the 1070's user; never OS-mute the box.

OWNER-RUN: this session runs when the owner asks for it (memory no-agent-eyetests). The launchers refuse to start Chrome while a person is using the box (box/hbgate.ps1 -> gate.log); if someone is on the box, stop.
Kill the test Chrome only by its D:\Temp\hbbench\<profile> user-data-dir (box/hbbench-kill.ps1 via `hbsess.mjs kill`); never taskkill /IM chrome.exe.

Tunnel, all three forwards: ssh -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=15 -o ServerAliveCountMax=4 -fN -L 9333:127.0.0.1:9333 -R 8765:127.0.0.1:8765 -R 8080:127.0.0.1:8080 young@100.127.215.75 (laptop: serve.py :8765 with --check green, holtburger-wsbridge :8080, ACE :9000/9001).

?nosw=1 on EVERY URL (hbsess.mjs adds it). A FRESH profile per arm and per rep: every `hbsess.mjs boot` writes a new D:\Temp\hbbench\hbb-sess-<ms> profile, so one boot = one arm-rep; never reuse a booted page for a second arm.

Uncapped frames: before the first boot, `ssh young@100.127.215.75 "echo 1> D:\Temp\hbbench\uncapped.txt"` (the launchers then add --disable-frame-rate-limit --disable-gpu-vsync; deploy the current box/*.bat to D:\Temp\hbbench\ first). Every URL also carries ?targetFps=0 (lib/bench-url.mjs); reads.json env.frameCap.fps must be 0.
Release wasm only: a dev wasm (name / .debug_* custom sections, harness/lib/wasm_profile.mjs) invalidates every timing in the session.

Single-login accounts: after `hbsess.mjs kill`, wait >= 65 s before the next boot on the same account (ACE reaps an un-goodbyed session at 60 s; harness/lib/boot.mjs INTER_ARM_GAP_MS), or alternate two bot accounts.

Reject, never average (PR-10): an arm-rep whose reads.json shows settle.quiet=false for a town, a non-empty tunnelHeld for a town (a census held while the portal tunnel ran: tunnel frames, not the world), env.gpu without '1070', or env.frameCap.fps != 0 is re-run, not averaged in.

accounts.driverGap: hbsess.mjs, hbprobe.mjs, hbbench.mjs hardcode account=tailnet1 (URL + the ACE-log account-free wait), and an appended `account=` in --flags loses to the first copy (URLSearchParams.get). So as written this recipe logs in as tailnet1: acceptable ONLY because the session is owner-run (batch-D rule: tailnet1 only for @tele* admin needs, coordinated with the owner). To run it on a bot instead, hbsess.mjs needs an --account option (requested of the orchestrator; not applied by the prep agent, whose file scope excluded existing scripts).

handoffVerbatim: - Reads: `__diag.render` (`renderDiag=on`), `__batchedRuns.stats` + `.frame()`, `__statBatchXStats()` (sorted vs unsorted split → settles F4), `__atlasStats()`.
- Plus one CPU profile, and one `gputrace.mjs` trace read with `gpu_thread_split.py`.
2. **`&batchedRuns=off`.** This is the per-range ANGLE term, and is arm 2 of the 10-19 fps review.
- **Rule:** if CrGpuMain WebGL ms/frame (on vs off) moves by less than the arm's own rep spread, the per-range term is not a lever. Stop P1 and L1, and re-plan.
- Read `__diag.pools()` (pools, classes, `mutationsThisFrame` = 0 parked), `subDraws` / `issuedSubDraws`, CrGpuMain WebGL ms, renderCPU.
- [2026-10-23] `negFace=off` dropped: the served v2 packs (world-packs-v5) serve every model with the default `negFace`, so this arm no longer changes the look.
- **Rule:** if `issuedSubDraws` or CrGpuMain WebGL ms rises against arm 1, F1 is confirmed and P3 must land L1 before any GATE-POOLS run.

items.reps: 3 per arm (2 minimum): arm 2's rule compares against the arm's own rep spread, so one rep cannot decide it. Rotate the arm order each rep (suggestedOrder).

towns.pathRules: Each stop: @teleloc, wait for the landing (target LB + within 8 m, <= 20 s), then for the portal tunnel to end (every hop plays it, same landblock included: >= 2 s CONTINUE + 1 s fade-out + 1 s world fade-in; <= 15 s, recorded as tele.tunnel), dwell 10 s on the chase camera recording rAF intervals and __batchedRuns.frame() every frame, then a 3-frame lite census (its tunnelActive must be false). No stop is near a portal (ACE activates a portal on collision: Portal.OnCollideObject). A stop that lands wrong (tele.landedOk false) is recorded and the path is NOT edited between arms — the path is fixed by its commands. Stop z = the NPC placement z + 0.5 m; the cell word = floor(x/24)*8 + floor(y/24) + 1 (checked against ace_world's own cell ids).

perArmRecipe: 1. node scripts/perf-worker/hbsess.mjs boot --quality ultra --flags 'renderDiag=on<ARM FLAGS>'   (fresh profile; boot gate on __bootStateHistory; @teleloc Holtburg; settle; camera parked on the __hbOrbit pose). Arm 3: this step IS 'Does it boot on HEAD?' — record the outcome and the boot-state history it prints on failure.

2. node scripts/perf-worker/gputrace.mjs <OUT>/<arm>-r<rep>-holtburg.trace.json   then   python3 -I scripts/perf-worker/gpu_thread_split.py <OUT>/<arm>-r<rep>-holtburg.trace.json   → CrGpuMain WEBGL ms/frame (+ RASTER, CrRendererMain busy). The first street-level sweep after boot (cold views), categories gpu.angle,gpu,toplevel (never gpu.service / gpu.decoder: ~10x inflation).

3. node scripts/perf-worker/hbsess.mjs orbit   then   node scripts/perf-worker/hbsess.mjs profile 10 <OUT>/<arm>-r<rep>-holtburg.cpuprofile   (prints {frames, fps})   → renderCPU = ms per frame INSIDE three's WebGLRenderer.render, counted by ANCESTOR (a nested render() counts once): `node scripts/net-review/profile-split-render.mjs <OUT>/<arm>-r<rep>-holtburg.cpuprofile` gives the 'INSIDE render()' share of all samples; renderCPU = that share × the profile's wall ms (`node -e "const p=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8'));console.log((p.endTime-p.startTime)/1000)" <OUT>/<arm>-r<rep>-holtburg.cpuprofile`) ÷ frames. Not proftree.py: its root sum drops a nested match only when the DIRECT parent matches, so the total depends on the target string chosen (2026-10-23 review).

4. node scripts/perf-worker/hbsess.mjs eval scripts/perf-worker/structure-p0.eval.js > <OUT>/<arm>-r<rep>-reads.json   → for Holtburg then Linvak Tukal: @teleloc, wait for the landing and the portal tunnel's end, settle (terrain + static node / instance counts quiet 12 s and 80% of the town's ring baked and resident, cap 150 s), fixed orbit, 30-frame still hold with renderer.info.autoReset off, every §7 read (census below), then the fixed @teleloc path. Leaves the page parked on the Linvak orbit with window.__hbOrbit pointing at it (several minutes; hbsess eval has no timeout).
5. node scripts/perf-worker/gputrace.mjs <OUT>/<arm>-r<rep>-linvak.trace.json   then   python3 -I scripts/perf-worker/gpu_thread_split.py on it   (Linvak's sweep is warm: the path already ran there).
6. node scripts/perf-worker/hbsess.mjs orbit   then   node scripts/perf-worker/hbsess.mjs profile 10 <OUT>/<arm>-r<rep>-linvak.cpuprofile
7. node scripts/perf-worker/hbsess.mjs kill; wait >= 65 s before the next boot on the same account.

decisionRules.writtenBeforeTheRun: **P0 — Measure (owner-run 1070 session, MODE T, a fresh profile per arm, `?nosw=1`, town at ultra: Holtburg and Linvak Tukal, settled AND on a fixed `@teleloc` path).** Decision rules are written here, before the run.
decisionRules.arm2: - **Rule:** if CrGpuMain WebGL ms/frame (on vs off) moves by less than the arm's own rep spread, the per-range term is not a lever. Stop P1 and L1, and re-plan.
decisionRules.arm3: - **Rule:** if `issuedSubDraws` or CrGpuMain WebGL ms rises against arm 1, F1 is confirmed and P3 must land L1 before any GATE-POOLS run.
decisionRules.scoringNote: Not part of the verbatim rules: compare per town and per condition (settled hold, path), arm vs arm 1 on the same town; 'rep spread' = max - min of the arm's own reps for that town. No fps prediction is made from any count (charter D-01.5): the rules read CrGpuMain WebGL ms and issuedSubDraws directly.

checklist: Every arm-rep: reads.json env.gpu names the GTX 1070, env.frameCap.fps === 0, both towns settle.quiet === true and tunnelHeld empty (else REJECT and re-run).
Every arm-rep: path rows recorded for all 4 stops per town; any tele.landedOk === false noted (path unchanged across arms); any tele.tunnel.active === true (the tunnel outlived the 15 s wait) noted.

Arm 1: census.summary.f4 recorded per town (F4); census.summary.f2 + census.atlas recorded (P1a live: geomDedupHits > 0, geomDedupCollisions === 0; F2's baseline is P0-FLAGS arm4); batchedRuns stats show draws > 0 (runs live).
Arm 2: census.batchedRuns.enabled === false and issuedPerFrame === subDrawsPerFrame (=off issues every range); CrGpuMain WEBGL ms/frame per rep — apply the arm-2 rule.
Arm 3: boot outcome on HEAD recorded; census.pools enabled, pools / classes / mutationsThisFrame; subDraws / issuedSubDraws; CrGpuMain WEBGL ms; renderCPU — apply the arm-3 rule.
Session end: test Chrome killed by user-data-dir; D:\Temp\hbbench\uncapped.txt left as the owner wants it.
out: RESULTS pointer + the two rule verdicts written back into this item's `result`.

Otherwise, if arm 3's issuedPerFrame is not below arm 3b's by more than the larger of the two arms' rep spreads (per town), poolRuns does not deliver F1's fix and 'wire L1 into opaque pools' stays open; read CrGpuMain WEBGL ms the same way.

It earns its default if arm 1's renderCPU is below this arm's beyond the spread. Measurement only: MODE T is off-screen, so the owner eye check P2 needs is still owed.
